entry_note: 8 T1-survivor combos (diversification gate active from T1 itself -- max_month_share=25%, max_asset_share=20% -- 9/24 combos passed all gates, 8/9 survive drop-top-2) pooled and traded simultaneously (not a single hand-picked parameterization) -- all long_only; no short-side combo survived drop-top-2 robustness.
exit_note: Frozen at T3 -- breakeven/chandelier/partial-profit variants all tested and none beat this baseline. A post-T7 exploratory stop-loss test (fixed R-multiple, empirical-percentile-calibrated, wider ATR-multiple, time-based, bar-close-confirmed) found NONE meaningfully reduced liquidation exposure without unacceptable edge cost -- no stop-loss variant adopted. IMPORTANT: ATR x 2.0 is a POSITION-SIZING / R-normalization unit only, NOT an executed protective stop order. Exits are purely signal-based (rank/quantile membership at rebalance). Intrabar adverse excursions are not capped by the strategy itself -- this is the direct cause of the T6 liquidation sensitivity below.
cluster_note: Research used a STATIC full-window (2020-2024) correlation map -- not available point-in-time live. Seed-selection non-determinism (Python set iteration order) was fixed prior to this candidate's T7/T8 runs (sorted seed order), so this trade set is reproducible run to run -- unlike candidate 12's original T5/T6 runs, which predated the fix. T9 must still implement a periodic rolling recompute (e.g. monthly, trailing 180d correlations) for live point-in-time use -- not yet built.
max_portfolio_heat_note: 20 max_open x 0.25% risk-per-trade = 5.0% theoretical max concurrent open risk.
fill_note: T6 tested limit fills (15bps inside open) -- 97.6% fill rate but SLIGHTLY worse avg_r among filled trades (adverse selection). Market-at-open is confirmed as the correct convention.
leverage_note: T6 liquidation sweep: 18.3% of trades would be liquidated before their modeled exit at 3x leverage (43.3% at 5x, 71.4% at 10x) -- nearly as leverage-sensitive as candidate 12 (21.6%/45.1%/71.8%), the highest of any candidate this session besides 12. A dedicated post-T7 stop-loss test found no exit-side mitigation that meaningfully helped (see exit_note) -- <=2x leverage is the ONLY confirmed effective mitigation, not an exit-engineering fix. <=2x also covers the theoretical worst-case stacking of 20 positions at the 10% per-position cap.
min_notional_note: Position sizing check (T6): actual notional at 0.25% risk ranged $184-$4,309 across the trade sample, 0.00% of trades below the $100 floor.
